description: Prerequisite audit of the proposed minimum-degree-three saturation program for the identical-terminal alternating ladder. The row is UNSAT before saturation: pole forcing excludes both cubic aligned poles required by X_x=y, X_y=x.
scope_note: The scripts verify canonical pole prerequisites and the reported abstract even-k arithmetic. They do not encode ears, degree saturation, Q, or graph realizability because the Type-T initial-state set is empty.
theorem: No canonical Type-T alternating-ladder saturation exists because the identical-terminal row is already eliminated by pole forcing. Q cannot change the canonical-pole prerequisite.
verification_limit: The CNF enumeration and DPLL checks take pole forcing as an input and verify prerequisite inconsistency only; they are not independent proofs of pole forcing.
